title: HTTP and Javalin
description: Serving data over HTTP: how a request travels from browser to server, HTTP methods, status codes and JSON, routes and handlers in Javalin, and lambdas as handlers, then the F16 Project 1 brief: an in-memory repository behind an interface wired end to end through routes and a service, with error responses.
